fields.name: guide_id
fields.comment: There must be a 1-to-1 mapping from guide_id to spacer.

fields.name: spacer
fields.description: The 5' to 3' targeting sequence of the gRNA.
fields.comment: All sequences must use ACTG notation.

fields.name: targeting
fields.description: Whether the guide targets a genomic locus relevant to the experiment.
fields.comment: If type ∈ {non-targeting, safe-targeting, negative control}, targeting must be FALSE. If targeting is FALSE, guide_chr, guide_start, guide_end, strand, pam, genomic_element, intended_target_name, intended_target_chr, intended_target_start, and intended_target_end may be NaN or empty.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Role of the guide in the experiment.
fields.comment: targeting = locus-directed guide; safe-targeting = targets inert genomic sites; non-targeting = does not bind any genomic target; positive control = expected measurable effect; negative control = should not modulate assay readout; variant = base/prime-editing installation or correction.

fields.name: guide_start
fields.comment: Coordinates follow half-open convention [start, end). Required if targeting is TRUE. Should not include PAM sequence.

fields.name: guide_end
fields.comment: Coordinates follow half-open convention [start, end). Should not include PAM sequence. Required if targeting is TRUE.

fields.name: strand
fields.description: Strand of the targeted genomic sequence.
fields.comment: Strand must be + or −. Required if targeting is TRUE.

fields.name: pam
fields.comment: Reported 5'→3' as it appears on the targeted strand immediately adjacent to the spacer. Required if targeting is TRUE.

fields.name: genomic_element
fields.description: Type of genomic element being targeted.
fields.comment: gene = gene body; distal element = >2 kb from a TSS when category unknown.

fields.name: intended_target_name
fields.comment: variant: SPDI ID (e.g., NC_00007.14:117548628:TT:TTT), promoter: ENSEMBL ID of regulated gene, enhancer/insulator/silencer/distal element: element coordinates (chr:start-end), splice site: ENSEMBL ID, Gene: ENSEMBL ID.

fields.name: intended_target_chr
fields.comment: For promoters, use promoter coordinates, not the regulated gene.

fields.name: intended_target_start
fields.description: 0-based start coordinate of the targeted element.
fields.comment: Promoters: use promoter coordinates. CRISPRa/i/KO: coordinates of regulatory element. Base/prime editing: coordinates of edit.

fields.name: intended_target_end
fields.description: 0-based end coordinate of the targeted element.

fields.name: putative_target_genes
fields.description: List of ENSEMBL IDs associated with the targeted element.
fields.comment: Required if type == positive control AND genomic_element ∈ {enhancer, insulator, silencer, distal element, splice site}. ENSEMBL IDs must correspond to GENCODE v43.

fields.name: imperfect
fields.description: Sequence of the corresponding perfect guide RNA.
fields.comment: If this field is present, the guide is an imperfect guide. See https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC9023296/.
